source: Codex 0.164.0 (@openai/codex 0.164.0, codex-linux-x64): turn.failed messages built from the usage-limit message parts and reset formats its binary holds (You’ve hit your usage limit…, ' Try again at ', ' or try again at ', ' or try again later.', '%-I:%M %p', '%b %-d' + st|nd|rd|th + ', %Y %-I:%M %p'), with Codex started in TZ=UTC.
